name: Basedash
description: Basedash is an AI-native business intelligence platform: ask questions about your data, run AI automations and get insights, charts and dashboards.

events.d: Ask Basedash AI about your data and get answer, charts and chat info. Select organization and optional wait time.
Get a chat message, including the assistant answer and its status.
Send a follow-up question in a chosen chat and get the assistant's answer; set an optional wait time.
Start a manual run of a selected automation.
Retrieve an insight's text, chart details, and raw chart data; choose organization, insight, and raw data paging.
Queue generation of a new AI insight for an organization.
Retrieve an automation run's final answer and charts by selecting organization, automation, and run.
Invite a user to an organization by email with a chosen role.
Runs when a new insight is created in a chosen organization.
